name: zinterp_object3d_scroll_always_tick_action
description: zInterp_Object3D::ScrollAlwaysTickAction walks the context scroll-always list from a driver node callback context and renders each target node.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zInterp parser/runtime source-cluster pass.
Binary Ninja renders VC boolean-normalization artifacts around sentinel comparisons; the source uses the equivalent direct sentinel loop.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4c5a00 validates the null wrapper-node early return, loading wrapperNode->callbackContext as zInterp_Context, reading scrollAlwaysListHead, walking entries until the sentinel head, and dispatching zInterp_Object3D::DefaultRenderAction for each entry payload node.
The native smoke verifies null-wrapper safety and two-entry sentinel-list traversal that updates both target model instances.
